entries.title: Exodus 40:1
segments: And the LORD spoke to Moses, saying,

entries.title: Exodus 40:2
segments: You shall set up the tabernacle of the tent of the congregation on the first day of the first month.

entries.title: Exodus 40:3
segments: And you shall put the ark of the testimony in it, and you hall cover the ark with the veil.

entries.title: Exodus 40:4
segments: And you shall bring the table in, and set in order its arrangement. And you shall bring the lampstand in and light the lamps of it.

entries.title: Exodus 40:5
segments: And you shall set the altar of gold for the incense in front of the ark of the testimony, and put the screen of the door to the tabernacle.

entries.title: Exodus 40:6
segments: And you shall set the altar of the burnt offering in front of the door of the tabernacle of the tent of the congregation.

entries.title: Exodus 40:7
segments: And you shall set the laver between the tent of the congregation and the altar, and shall put water in it.

entries.title: Exodus 40:8
segments: And you shall set up the court all around, and place the screen at the court gate.

entries.title: Exodus 40:9
segments: And you shall take the anointing oil and anoint the tabernacle, and all in it, and shall sanctify it and all the vessels of it. And it shall be holy.

entries.title: Exodus 40:10
segments: And you shall anoint the altar of the burnt offering, and all its vessels, and sanctify the altar. And it shall be a most holy altar.

entries.title: Exodus 40:11
segments: And you shall anoint the laver and its base, and sanctify it.

entries.title: Exodus 40:12
segments: And you shall bring Aaron and his sons to the door of the tabernacle of the congregation, and wash them with water.

entries.title: Exodus 40:13
segments: And you shall put the holy garments on Aaron, and anoint him and sanctify him, so that he may minister to Me in the priest's office.

entries.title: Exodus 40:14
segments: And you shall bring his sons and clothe them [with] tunics.

entries.title: Exodus 40:15
segments: And you shall anoint them, even as you anointed their father, so that they may minister to Me in the priest's office. For their anointing shall surely be an everlasting priesthood for their generations.

entries.title: Exodus 40:16
segments: And Moses did so. According to all that the LORD commanded him, so he did.

entries.title: Exodus 40:17
segments: And it will be in the first month in the second year, on the first of the month, the tabernacle was reared up.

entries.title: Exodus 40:18
segments: And Moses reared up the tabernacle and fastened its sockets, and set up its boards, and put in its bars, and reared up its pillars.

entries.title: Exodus 40:19
segments: And he spread the tent over the tabernacle and put the covering of the tent above upon it, even as the LORD commanded Moses.

entries.title: Exodus 40:20
segments: And he took and placed the Testimony into the ark, and set the staves on the ark, and put the mercy-seat on the ark from above.

entries.title: Exodus 40:21
segments: And he brought the ark into the tabernacle and set up the veil of the covering, and covered the Ark of Testimony, even as the LORD commanded Moses.

entries.title: Exodus 40:22
segments: And he put the table in the tent of the congregation, on the side of the tabernacle northward, outside the veil.

entries.title: Exodus 40:23
segments: And he set the bread in order upon it before the LORD, even as the LORD had commanded Moses.

entries.title: Exodus 40:24
segments: And he put the lampstand in the tent of the congregation across from the table, on the side of the tabernacle southward.

entries.title: Exodus 40:25
segments: And he set up the lamps before the LORD, even as the LORD commanded Moses.

entries.title: Exodus 40:26
segments: And he put the golden altar in the tent of the congregation in front of the veil.

entries.title: Exodus 40:27
segments: And he burned sweet incense on it, even as the LORD commanded Moses.

entries.title: Exodus 40:28
segments: And he set up the screen [at] the door of the tabernacle.

entries.title: Exodus 40:29
segments: And he put the altar of burnt offering [by] the door of the tabernacle of the tent of the congregation, and offered on it the burnt offering and the food offering, even as the LORD commanded Moses.

entries.title: Exodus 40:30
segments: And he set the laver between the tent of the congregation and the altar, and put water there, for washing.

entries.title: Exodus 40:31
segments: And Moses and Aaron and his sons washed their hands and their feet there.

entries.title: Exodus 40:32
segments: When they went into the tent of the congregation, and when they came near the altar, they washed, even as the LORD commanded Moses.

entries.title: Exodus 40:33
segments: And he reared up the court all around the tabernacle and the altar, and set up the screen of the court gate. And Moses finished the work.

entries.title: Exodus 40:34
segments: And the cloud covered the tabernacle of the congregation, and the glory of the LORD filled the tabernacle.

entries.title: Exodus 40:35
segments: And Moses was not able to enter into the tabernacle of the congregation because the cloud stayed on it, and the glory of the LORD filled the tabernacle.

entries.title: Exodus 40:36
segments: And when the cloud was taken up from over the tabernacle, the sons of Israel journeyed on in all their journeys.

entries.title: Exodus 40:37
segments: But if the cloud was not taken up, then they did not journey until the day that it was taken up.

entries.title: Exodus 40:38
segments: For the cloud of the LORD [was] upon the tabernacle by day, and fire was on it by night, in the sight of all the house of Israel, in all their journeys.
